scope: RLMS H4 retrospective correction, not new independent confirmation
query_score: current minimax value minus worst post-answer minimax value, divided by price, for BOTH query types
tie_break: worst-case width reduction per cost, cheaper action, lower row/horizon; exact identical actions prefer point

main.window: latest eligible complete window per person

P0_fix: Use exact first-exit marginal supports including all-known-one prefixes; P0 is exact on complete paths
legacy_interpretation: engineering replay on historical head(n) rows; repeated persons/windows are not an independent cost study
price_interpretation: assumed query costs, not measured recontact expenses
